quarterly_data.quarter: Infleqtion press release: NASA Awards Infleqtion $20 Million as World's First Quantum (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NASA awarded Infleqtion a $20 million follow-on contract to continue development of the Quantum Gravity Gradiometer Pathfinder (QGGPf), a mission led by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory designed to fly the world's first space-based quantum gravity sensor; the award brings NASA's investment in the program to $40 million and moves it into the next phase of hardware development and testing. Infleqtion designs, matures and integrates the atomic physics package (vacuum, laser and control subsystems; ultracold rubidium atoms) and in this phase will build an initial sensor head and electronics engineering development unit for testing at the Einstein Elevator drop tower in Hannover, Germany; the phase's work is expected to run through 2027, and the mission is expected to launch in 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: $20 million follow-on contract; NASA investment in the program $40 million; launch expected in 2030
